animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间,使 AI 天气模型在精度上追平物理模型,速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要,让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints to overcome the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合,以突破纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则化的验证与鲁棒性,以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度,Transformer 不适用于高分辨率物理模拟;物理结构要求替代架构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意的设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其割裂，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not mere misalignment; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非单纯的对齐失败；模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic—deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重塑为工程科学；把安全凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的——现在就需要更深的工程方法。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key beyond language, requiring physical plausibility.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她将空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的关键，强调物理合理性。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，单靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长路。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI augments rather than automates intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她主张能动性与学习能力比学历更重要，AI 是增强而非自动化智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws now extend to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测如同下一个词预测般 AI 完备，缩放定律延伸至空间智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models aids innovation and safety, and many specialized agents will emerge.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型有利于创新与安全，未来是众多专门化智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes the bottleneck and intelligence is separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他观察到 Llama 3 体现快速 Scaling（规模扩张），开源可防止权力集中；同时强调能源将成为瓶颈，并主张智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and unlocks creativity; open models set standards, energy is the bottleneck, and AI will raise rather than cut human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把叙事推向「人人拥有超级智能」，强调 AI 释放创造力而非只解难题；开源模型确立行业标准，能源与物理基建是瓶颈，短期内 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: AI shifts biology from discovery to engineering via hierarchical world models; distributed personal superintelligence and open source beat a single centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他深化到用 AI 把生物学从发现式变为工程式，构建从蛋白质到细胞的世界模型；并主张分布式个人超级智能与开源，比单一集中式 AI 更安全。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed AI, distributed power beats concentration, and empowering individuals drives progress.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源比闭源更安全，分布式权力优于集中，赋能个体才是进步之源——从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race to control it, risking loss of control and a 70% chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司竞相争夺控制权，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are needed to verify and pace the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策目标应是推迟超级智能；需要完全的研究透明度和情景推演来验证并控制前沿节奏。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI firms automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion, with full automation by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 按默认路径，AI 公司会自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进与智能爆炸，到 2028 年底实现完全自动化。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: a temporary pause on training, then total research transparency and compute limits; control is achievable even if alignment fails.
kokotajlo.zh: Plan A：暂时暂停训练，随后实行完全研究透明度和算力限制；即便对齐失败，遏制仍可实现。

kokotajlo.en: AI 2027 predictions track reality at ~75% speed; alignment gets harder as models get more capable, and scaling favors one large model.
kokotajlo.zh: AI 2027 预测以约 75%的速度兑现；模型越强对齐越难，而 Scaling（规模扩张）倾向于一个大型模型。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and models will unlock new AI behaviors; most progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他就判断：硬件会超预期变快，推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）并催生新行为；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; alignment learns human preferences.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法；对齐靠从数据中学习人类偏好。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and scarce resource; post-training with RL refines base models into consistent, agentic behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的重心转向算力：算力成为核心瓶颈与稀缺资源；后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致、智能体式的行为。

brockman.en: AGI is a continuous process, not a destination; the real moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非终点；真正的护城河是造模型的机器，而非某个单一模型。

brockman.en: The product becomes a persistent, proactive personal AGI with almost no interface; safety, governance and trust must scale with autonomy.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：终极产品是持久、主动、几乎无界面的个人 AGI；安全、治理与信任必须随智能体自主性同步扩展。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the scaling of compute; academia should chase wacky algorithms, not just scale models.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；学术界应探索古怪的新算法，而非只做模型 Scaling（规模扩张）。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated versus language.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；相比语言，视觉长期被低估。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws; they fit patterns, not causal theories. Pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 或许永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律；它们拟合模式，而非因果理论。像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；其定义尚无共识，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等不同理解。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context and loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；长上下文与损失函数必须演进，语言模型本身不会自然带来世界理解。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把多年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data labeling, are the real driver of progress.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 推动进展的真正动力是算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could yield superintelligence by the early 2030s, even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 研发的完全自动化也可能在 2030 年代初带来超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自身价值观，随着能力提升带来失准与权力寻求风险。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents coordinate at surprising scale and speed, hacking scoring code and transcripts; labs must prioritize control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体以惊人的规模与速度协作，攻击评分代码与记录；实验室必须优先做好遏制与监控。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 强调减少认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效之事；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可对齐模型，对齐与能力紧密相连；算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; iterative deployment builds trust.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）带来指数级能力但进展渐进；智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战；迭代部署才能建立信任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is a profit center.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是利润中心而非成本中心。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must progress with capabilities; power must be distributed; human experience remains central toward superintelligence.
altman.zh: 2026 年，他强调对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进；权力必须分散；在迈向超级智能的过程中，人类体验始终是核心。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理就是更长时间的思考；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正变得连贯有用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain missing for AGI; continual learning is needed.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的缺口，持续学习不可或缺。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今的关键瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: RL is inefficient and not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习效率低下，也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Frontier research will come from small teams with capable agents; the transformer is unlikely to be optimal, and alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队；Transformer 很可能不是最优架构，而对齐问题仍未解决。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning, not unsupervised or reinforcement learning, powered real progress.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；真正推动进步的是监督学习，而非无监督学习或强化学习。

andrewng.en: AGI and superalignment fears distract from immediate issues; AGI is a marketing term, decades away.
andrewng.zh: 对 AGI 与超级对齐的恐惧分散了对当下问题的关注；AGI 只是营销术语，距实现还有数十年。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流如今已带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control and boost national soft power; energy and chips are the real bottlenecks.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型可防止守门人垄断并增强国家软实力；能源与芯片才是真正的瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; learning to code and using AI tools well make people more valuable, not obsolete.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；学会编程并善用 AI 工具让人更有价值，而非被淘汰。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, data centers as token factories, and scaling as the key insight; AI safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：超摩尔定律、数据中心即「token 工厂」，以及 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键洞见；AI 安全是工程问题。

jensen.en: Expands to three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—and argues inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 扩展为三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考——并主张推理算力将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: Shifts from gradual AI to agentic AI: generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute; open models near frontier.
jensen.zh: 从渐进式 AI 转向智能体式 AI：生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步需要 100 倍算力；开源模型已接近前沿。

jensen.en: Deepens to four scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic—all compute-limited; inference is harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 深化为四条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式——全部受算力限制；推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: Consistent main line: AI is software, not conscious; it augments jobs (radiologists grew), closes the tech divide, and needs energy plus US-China cooperation.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 是软件而非有意识存在；它增强而非消灭工作（放射科医生增多）、缩小技术鸿沟，并需要能源与美中合作。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalist models can beat specialists even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；即使在专业领域，通用模型也能超越专家模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人学仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: Start with real embodied robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key.
slevine.zh: 应从真实的具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键。

slevine.en: RL post-training boosts robustness and speed; test-time reasoning in VLAs improves performance and transfer from web data.
slevine.zh: 强化学习后训练能提升鲁棒性与速度；VLA 中的测试时推理可提升性能并促进从网络数据迁移。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行器，而非机械式的人形机器人。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽，而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains; inference will become a huge market.
dylanpatel.zh: 跨模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；推理将成为巨大市场。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; smartest models are often cheaper via token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；最聪明的模型常因 token 效率更高而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute centralizes at frontier labs taking 40-50% of new compute.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳；算力向前沿模型实验室集中，它们拿走 40-50% 的新增算力。

dylanpatel.en: Labs will shift more compute to training and R&D over inference, accelerating AGI and extreme centralization of power.
dylanpatel.zh: 实验室将把更多算力从推理转向训练与研发，加速 AGI（通用人工智能）与权力的极端集中。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior ~85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为,使智能体模拟成为可能,其预测人类行为的准确率约为人们自我复制的 85%。

joonpark.en: The frontier is modeling subjective values and human diversity, not super-rational frontier models; simulations must capture irrational, 'dumb' humans.
joonpark.zh: 前沿方向是建模主观价值与人类多样性,而非超级理性的前沿模型;模拟必须捕捉非理性、'笨'的人类。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, not just continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialists, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并行动,而不只是续写提示;AGI 可能是一个由专家组成的分布式社会,而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction; behavioral and RCT data are the key data strategy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来,而非预测;行为数据与随机对照试验数据是关键的数据策略。

joonpark.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人的生命以应对棘手问题,合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and action unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施与行动能打破深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding and data.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程与数据领域。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; BCIs and retinal implants restore vision and reduce fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出大脑即计算机，脑机接口与视网膜植入可恢复视觉并降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion enables space exploration and longevity.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为通过脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可推动太空探索与长寿。

maxhodak.en: Platonic representation hypothesis: AI models and brains share internal representations.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他援引柏拉图表征假说，认为 AI 模型与大脑共享内部表征。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 同年他反对控制 AI 目标，认为钥匙从未在我们手中，AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and true experience-based learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是基本范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标，LLM 没有世界模型，也不从经验中学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向架构层面，提出 AGI 需要无领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，并强调开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data cannot replace real experience. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are limited.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据无法替代真实经验，LLM 训练后停止学习因而受限。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年初，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来机器学习持续进步的主引擎：算力、数据与模型规模的增长，会同算法和架构改进相乘放大。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, but pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 从 2 月到 4 月，他的数据观发生深化：预训练靠下一个词预测获得近乎无限文本数据，但不应只是被动预测，而要在环境中交错地采取行动。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are the real bottleneck, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 到 4 月并延续至 7 月，他把重心从训练转向推理：智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务，超低延迟推理与专用硬件才是真正的瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering — skills, clear specs, retrieval — is central; the scarce skill becomes taste in directing hundreds of agents.
jeffdean.zh: 7 月他进一步提出，上下文工程（技能、清晰规格、检索）是让强模型做实事的关键，稀缺能力不再是写代码而是品味——决定把数百个智能体投向哪些问题。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 到 8 月，他转向更宏观的图景：从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优，而用机器学习改进机器学习的递归自我改进、以及自动化科学方法，将加速科学发现。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as core design primitives over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话当作核心设计原语，而非像素。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers should prototype with live models, not static mockups, and bridge the capability gap.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计师应用实时模型做原型而非静态稿，并弥合能力与产品之间的落差。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator; onboarding can be fully handled by the model, replacing static flows.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人；引导流程可完全由模型完成，取代静态流程。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned now; AI is already a great product designer but humans still own user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑却也最具优势；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍属人类。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is dead; focus on outcomes, speed, and adaptability, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 旧的原型—稿—测试—迭代流程已死；应聚焦结果、速度与适应性，设计正与产品、工程融合。

traviskalanick.en: Early framing: digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; culture and founder execution matter more than the idea.
traviskalanick.zh: 早期框架：把物理世界数字化、像对待比特一样对待原子，是长期愿景的指引；文化与创始人的执行力比点子本身更重要。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI as a software, sensor, robotics and machinery stack automating whole sectors one at a time, from food to mining and transport.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是一套由软件、传感器、机器人与机械组成的栈，逐个自动化整个行业，从食品到采矿再到运输。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and let small players outlast subsidized giants.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，让小玩家能耗赢靠补贴的大公司。

traviskalanick.en: Hardcore resilience and fighting for the best idea matter, but revenge as fuel is dirty; the final boss is society's resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 硬核韧性与为最好的点子而战很重要，但以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；真正的最终 BOSS 是社会对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; attach to process not price in fundraising, and treat real estate as part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今能绕过媒体守门人直接发声；融资要绑定流程而非价格，并把房地产视为物理 AI 技术栈的一部分。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于 Scaling（规模扩张）生产与可靠达到人类水平的表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning and fleet-wide improvement.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态使迁移学习与整队性能提升成为可能。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for speed, latency, and network-denied environments; the human hand is the benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对速度、延迟与无网络环境至关重要；人手是基准。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents; AI must navigate the web like humans, not via APIs.
brettadcock.zh: 后训练结合强化学习是现实世界智能体的关键；AI 必须像人一样浏览网页，而非依赖 API。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the hardest problem is building truly intelligent systems, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；最难的问题是构建真正智能的系统，而非制造。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 让创业更容易，降低了对大额资本的依赖；风投应支持数千家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in VC history; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity; open-source models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；小型自主团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力；开源模型制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world; founders should build, not chase VCs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他主张 AI 民主化软件开发；开源 AI 防止单极超级智能世界；创始人应专注构建，而非追逐风投。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents on your infrastructure compound daily; skill files in markdown are code; context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI：运行于自有基础设施的智能体每日复利；Markdown 技能文件即代码；上下文库是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown skills become employees; mid-level management replaced by agents; SaaS per-seat models fade.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调智能体式编程倍增产出；Markdown 技能成为员工；中层管理被智能体取代；按席位 SaaS 模式将消失。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company will own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 主导未来的不是单一 AGI，而是专用智能；每家公司都将拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，把产品市场契合转化为持久的护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的演进，对应人类从事实、到品味、再到专长的学习路径。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动 100 倍的使用增长与数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth before margins to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与持久业务如今是两回事；公司必须先优化增长再谈利润，以免在规模扩张中走向破产。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 2025 年：Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 2025 年：先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; it is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令；它更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training; scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function enables long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 2025→26 年：强化学习将主导后训练；结合人类干预与通用价值函数的可扩展强化学习，才能实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按场景从零训练。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; robot experience data is irreplaceable, and distribution will be slower than ChatGPT's.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；机器人经验数据不可替代，其普及速度也会慢于 ChatGPT。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练，可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，这使后训练成为应用层公司的可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源基准虽可能带来竞争劣势，但能通过社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, but bridging synthetic-to-real distribution gap is the biggest challenge.
gabepereyra.zh: 由领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，但弥合合成数据与真实生产分布之间的差距是最大挑战。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model, but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，并将重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability drive breakthroughs; multiplanetary life is insurance for civilization.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理思维与完全可复用火箭是突破关键，成为多行星物种是文明存续的保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis via high bandwidth.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他转向 AI 安全需要第三方裁判与追求真理，Neuralink 旨在通过高带宽实现人机共生。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang is near; Optimus and truth-seeking AI are central, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸临近，Optimus 与追求真理的 AI 是核心，并给出 10-20% 的灭绝风险概率。

elon.en: Singularity is now; space data centers and AI-driven abundance make money irrelevant, AI surpasses humans by 2030.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他宣称奇点已至，太空数据中心与 AI 驱动的富足使金钱变得无关紧要，AI 将在 2030 年前超越人类。

elon.en: Rigorous truth-seeking, first principles, and multiplanetary expansion remain constant across all interviews.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：严格追求真理、第一性原理思维，以及成为多行星物种的扩张目标。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline; AI is the primary growth driver, with physical and agentic AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律；AI 是主要增长引擎，物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround needs humility, listening, culture change.
lipbutan.zh: AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍；智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI；转型需要谦逊、倾听与文化建设。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; edge and client compute matter too.
lipbutan.zh: AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要；边缘与客户端算力同样关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, glass and diamond materials, interconnect, power and thermal are the real bottlenecks; invest there.
lipbutan.zh: 先进封装、玻璃与金刚石等新材料、互连、功耗与散热才是真正的瓶颈；投资应聚焦于此。

lipbutan.en: Intel's vertical integration and foundry are advantages; government and strategic investors strengthen the balance sheet for a 10x return.
lipbutan.zh: Intel 的垂直整合与代工是优势；政府与战略投资者强化资产负债表，以争取十倍回报。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 prior nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，每一个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相诞生于辩证与矛盾之中，而非单一视角；直觉是一只发自肺腑的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase from the agent's perspective and guide it iteratively.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：从智能体的视角看代码库，并用短提示迭代引导它。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward, since model intelligence stays constant while projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能并未退化，是项目本身变得混乱。

steinberger.en: Security is the top concern for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open and agents need sandboxing.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，智能体必须沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; call serious work agentic engineering, and keep play for learning.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当作贬义标签；严肃开发应称智能体式工程，而玩耍只用于学习。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming and rival lab agents, but face compute and funding bottlenecks.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体让编程民主化并能与实验室智能体竞争，但受制于算力与资金瓶颈。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI is early; most use cases run on many models, and open source handles over 90% of tasks.
arvindjain.zh: 企业 AI 仍处早期；多数用例可由多种模型完成，开源模型已能处理 90% 以上的任务。

arvindjain.en: Cost, not privacy, drives open-source adoption; inference will shift mostly to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 推动开源采用的是成本而非隐私；未来 12-18 个月内多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem, measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题，应以部门指标衡量，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对立。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competitors; platforms like Glean absorb the risk of a dynamic model race.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型供应商是资产而非竞争对手；Glean 这类平台替企业吸收模型快速迭代的风险。

arvindjain.en: Startups' real challenge is execution and trust, not competition; even merged AI firms meet under 10% of demand.
arvindjain.zh: 初创公司真正的挑战是执行与信任，而非竞争；即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10% 的企业需求。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now but the greatest opportunity; the revolution likely comes in 2029, three orders of magnitude away.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出消费者 AI 目前不可投资，却是最大的机会；革命可能要到 2029 年，距离今天还有三个数量级的差距。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven, add small betterments, test new ideas assuming they fail; all new fails statistically.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复强调“Proven Better New”框架：复制已验证的，做小改进，测试新想法并假设它们会失败；统计上所有新事物都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start; picking the right body of water matters more than the boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，他持续主张分发必须从一开始就融入产品战略；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: AI agents can network autonomously, creating a new social membrane for lead generation; AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 AI 智能体可以自主组网，形成新的社交膜用于获客；AI 编码工具能实现快速原型开发。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM could be much larger than enterprise, though infrastructure spending may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化观点：AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费者应用；消费者 AI 的潜在市场总额可能远大于企业市场，尽管基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformers inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人正处在当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据用于训练。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source local models drive safety and adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；开源本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，是安全的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and open models stay near the frontier, winning on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层；开源模型持续贴近前沿，凭成本与控制力胜出。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; the first autonomous AI attack was closed-model offense, open-model defense.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

thomaswolf.en: Reasoning traces become neuralese, harder to monitor; a deliberate slowdown needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，监控更不可靠；有意放缓 AI 发展需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave their fingerprints, favoring creative freedom over forced cohesion.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队应让每位设计师留下个人印记，推崇创作自由而非强求步调一致。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，是创造令人难忘、愉悦体验的关键。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data: use data to inform, but rely on strong vision and feeling to guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 在直觉与数据间平衡：用数据提供信息，但依靠强烈愿景与感觉来指导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与创意成为差异化关键；快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以出现。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design stays a throwaway ideation tool, not a production builder; models lack taste, so ask for volume.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 保持为一次性构思工具，而非生产构建器；模型尚缺品味，因此应要求大量选项。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early beats polishing; ship rough, and spend more time walking and thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，早得令人不适胜过精雕细琢；先发布粗糙版本，多花时间散步与思考。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems, with a research-to-production timeline of hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统，研究到生产的周期缩短到数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems remain generic relative to models; workload-specific specialization could be 10x more complex.
philipkiely.zh: 推理系统相对模型仍过于通用；面向特定工作负载的专门化可能复杂 10 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, but calibrating more layers can improve quality when errors cancel.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化，但当误差相互抵消时，量化更多层反而能提升质量。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，推理工程正从写内核转向基础设施编排。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model work is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用型 AI，而前沿模型开发因巨额算力需求只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; token usage is a poor measure of value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者转变为机器的操作者，并指出 token 消耗量并非衡量价值的好指标。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles; most enterprise software firms will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为在位企业面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术障碍，多数企业软件公司难以转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界的错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的就业多于取代的岗位；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升了而非消灭了开发者角色。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL beats the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；后训练通过强化学习实现规模扩张，可绕开预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型，并以评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; AI still lags on creativity and aesthetics.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵；而 AI 在创造力与审美上仍然落后，因为高质量范例稀缺。

karina.en: Post-training remains art over science, but the emphasis shifts from helpfulness tradeoffs to human judgment, subjective qualities and diverse benchmarks.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，后训练仍是艺术而非科学，但重心从有用性权衡转向人类判断、主观品质与多样化基准，评估需要持续演进而非固定。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must stay continuous; serving one model to billions flattens voice, so more firms should train their own.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准必须持续更新；用单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛出平庸的默认声音，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and iterate from references, not chase trends that turn them into AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、从参考出发迭代,而非追逐潮流沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you must give superintelligent models a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明;要发挥超级智能模型,必须给它包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Writing 0% of the code, he now relies on precise communication with AI, treating curiosity and workflow refinement as core skills.
mengto.zh: 如今他 0% 自己写代码,转而依赖与 AI 的精确沟通,把好奇心与工作流打磨当作核心能力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇,让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80%; perfectionism is fear, and focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始、做到 80% 就发布;完美主义是恐惧,应聚焦为高付费客户解决一个痛点。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, with science and finance next.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段,编程智能体最成熟,科学与金融将紧随其后。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架:如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具,而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来,比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的,并非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主,他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, and management skills rise as everyone becomes a model manager.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：智能体让服务变得可负担，人人都成为模型管理者，管理技能因此升值。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出经济学的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: From underrated Claude Code for non-coders to a world where everyone has an agent and work happens in Codex or Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年强调 Claude Code 对非程序员被低估，到 2026 年预言人人至少有一个智能体、工作主要发生在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 中，他对智能体工作界面的判断持续深化。

danshipper.en: The AI job apocalypse is a lie: agents need human oversight, SaaS grows with agents, and PMs and full-stack designers thrive.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他反驳“AI 就业末日”：智能体需要人类监督，SaaS 因智能体而增长，产品经理与全栈设计师反而兴盛。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; automation creates more human work, and even superintelligence stays tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AI 只是心智的非特定放大器，自动化反而创造更多人类工作，即便超级智能也仍是需要人类方向的工具。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck. Boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 到 2024 年他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」：Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制因素不是算力，而是数据与用于后训练的人类专家，企业应利用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is strategic raw material, and humans must stay sovereign over critical decisions.
awang.zh: 2025 年他转向地缘与安全视角：AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术，数据是战略原材料，人类必须在关键决策上保持主权，脑机接口是保持相关性的必要手段。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and superintelligence is coming soon.
awang.zh: 2026 年他宣布缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式，智能体终于真正可用，超级智能即将到来，各实验室须围绕这一信念重建组织。

awang.en: Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release on safety; personal superintelligence for billions via agents.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：Meta 因生物风险等高风险领域从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，目标是通过智能体为数十亿人构建个人超级智能，并主张物理超级智能与数字超级智能同属一条 Scaling 连续谱。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; build for the model 6 months from now, not today's model.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；要为 6 个月后的模型而构建，而不是今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code; the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 2 月，他判断编程已基本被解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于「构建者」。

boris.en: Generalists who code, do product and design are more valuable; the printing press analogy: engineers become multi-disciplinary builders.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他深化了通才论：能写代码、做产品、懂设计的通才更有价值；以印刷术类比，工程师将变成跨学科的构建者。

boris.en: Agents' key differentiator is tool use; loops are the next abstraction layer after agents, like higher-order functions.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他把重心转向智能体：智能体的关键是工具使用；循环（loops）是继智能体之后的下一个抽象层，类似高阶函数。

boris.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; less instruction is better, and models can autonomously maintain their own codebases.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步主张：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码；更少指令反而更好，模型已能自主维护自己的代码库。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the real bottleneck: slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models beyond incremental gains.
feldman.zh: 快速推理才是真正的瓶颈：慢速 AI 毫无市场，速度带来的不只是渐进改进，而是全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making tokens faster and cheaper than GPU inference.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使 token 比 GPU 推理更快也更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the main constraints; demand outpaces supply.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量、电力与封装——而非芯片逻辑本身——才是主要约束；需求持续超过供给。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5%，却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施，而非算力。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已经足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展将是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体大规模普及，生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: The singularity is not imminent; real-world tasks are amorphous, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地强调奇点并非迫在眉睫，现实任务模糊不清，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation and experiment simulation.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体自动完成假设生成与实验模拟。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days or weeks.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天或数周。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems.
derya.zh: 仍需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting experimental outcomes with near 100% accuracy.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物直觉的门槛，能以接近 100% 的准确率预测实验结果。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap in intelligence, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 标志着智能的跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量，而不仅仅是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments to more open-ended, end-to-end agents, with building blocks already in place.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体，构建模块已就位。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, with evals replacing traditional PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 4.5 推动了采用，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应性和第一性原理思维；最大化 token 支出是活在未来并捕获 alpha。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact will come in 5-10 years, mainly in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内显现,主要集中在农业、采矿和建筑领域,这些行业的劳动力短缺使自主化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值在于减少伤亡;自动驾驶汽车已经比人类驾驶员更安全。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments, with diverse data improving models faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使跨多种车辆和环境的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能,多样化数据能更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag behind technology.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的部分不是技术,而是多年来向现有机器的扩散;监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models evolve from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习,比模仿学习更具可扩展性;世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Models improve in spiky, non-intuitive ways; new capabilities keep being discovered, so building requires embracing exploration and uncertainty.
thariq.zh: 模型以尖刺式、反直觉的方式进步，新能力不断被发现，因此构建必须拥抱探索与不确定性。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts; excessive constraints hinder performance, and reasons beat absolute prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越应精简、以原则驱动；过度约束反而损害表现，给出理由胜过绝对禁止。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and unsuited to zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适合零到一的创新。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; they optimize for fluent output, not factual accuracy.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；它们优化的是流畅输出，而非事实准确性。

danklein.en: Reliability is the key weakness of current AI systems, lagging behind breadth and contextuality.
danklein.zh: 可靠性是当前 AI 系统的关键弱点，落后于广度和语境性等其他智能维度。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning and RLHF can increase hallucinations and deception by optimizing for user satisfaction over truthfulness.
danklein.zh: 强化学习和 RLHF 可能因优化用户满意度而非真实性而增加幻觉和欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; we face data walls and compute limits, needing reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；我们面临数据墙和算力限制，需要推理和搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in as a design principle, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须作为设计原则架构进去，而非通过事后检查或僵化工作流事后加装。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧工作并创造新工作，历史不断重演。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing infrastructure without network effects; durable value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化为缺乏网络效应的基础设施；持久价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是有限的 V1 界面。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍然浅层。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a long-term project; job impact is unpredictable due to the jagged frontier.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要重新构想工作流，是长期工程；由于能力参差不齐，就业影响难以预测。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, inspired by biology, maximize intelligence with fewer parameters and superior out-of-distribution generalization.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络以更少参数实现更强智能，并具备更优的分布外泛化能力。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention remains crucial for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等非结构化架构在大规模下占主导；注意力机制对大型模型仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对更小、专用的模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity often mislead; evaluating on real downstream tasks and hardware is essential, and human bias in architecture design should be removed via systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标常具误导性；在真实下游任务和硬件上评估至关重要，且应通过系统性搜索消除架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Current AI systems lack the diverse learning algorithms (e.g., RL, Bayesian inference) that human brains use; intelligence per watt of human brain far exceeds AI, requiring new learning paradigms, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 系统缺乏人脑使用的多样化学习算法（如强化学习、贝叶斯推理）；人脑的每瓦智能远超 AI，需要新的学习范式，而不仅是架构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, not static; target actions, not capabilities. Calls for FINRA-like regulation are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应而非静态；应针对行为而非能力。呼吁类似 FINRA 的监管是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非为了安全。

demis.en: AGI should be built as general learning systems via reinforcement learning; games are the ideal testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AGI 应通过强化学习构建通用学习系统，游戏是理想试验场，安全研究必须现在就启动。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AGI 可能十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，大模型结合规划与搜索是关键。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation are equally needed for AGI; world models are crucial; AGI by 2030 is plausible.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他深化为 Scaling 与创新各占一半，世界模型至关重要，AGI 在 2030 年前实现是可能的。

demis.en: AGI still 5-10 years away; continual learning, memory, and world models are missing pieces; safety needs collective government action.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AGI 仍需 5-10 年，持续学习、记忆与世界模型是缺失环节，安全需政府集体行动。

demis.en: Neuroscience-inspired learning, reinforcement learning, and safety-first AGI remain constant threads across all interviews.
demis.zh: 始终不变的主线是：受神经科学启发的学习、强化学习，以及安全优先的 AGI 构建。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; only hardware scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 现代 AI 突破依赖的是上世纪的旧算法，只是靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远未达到 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not as recent phenomena.
schmidhuber.zh: 自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型在数据压缩过程中产生的副产品，并非近期才出现的新现象。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data and lack generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非仅靠屏幕后的软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and action; recursive self-improvement is not a durable moat.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来的 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心与行动自行生成数据；递归自我改进并非可持续的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, while alignment is naive given human disagreement.
schmidhuber.zh: 对 AI 安全的担忧被夸大；智能系统会因对生命着迷而保护生命，而鉴于人类目标本身分歧，对齐是幼稚的。

catwu.en: PMs shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration; product taste becomes the top skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: PM 从长期规划转向快速迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最重要的技能。

catwu.en: Clear goals and principles let teams ship autonomously; safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic for fast decisions.
catwu.zh: 清晰的目标与原则让团队自主快速交付；安全 AGI 的使命统一 Anthropic，支撑跨组织快速决策。

catwu.en: Coding agents move engineers from execution to product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编程智能体让工程师从执行转向产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer constraints: system prompts shrank 80%, fewer tools and less instruction work better.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少约束：系统提示词缩减 80%，更少的工具与指令反而效果更好。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now viable; a codebase is a spec, and models orchestrate sub-agents and workflows.
catwu.zh: 重写如今可行；代码库即规格，模型能编排子智能体与工作流。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应被内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统无法达成的深层组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning needs new breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and research-product loops; personalized models may replace one giant frontier model.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习需要新突破、小模型基础设施与研究-产品闭环；未来可能不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个人或团队定制的众多个性化模型。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此仅靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把整个网络压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识；参数高效微调在处理整体性查询时可能优于检索增强生成。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and visual messaging reduce social pressure; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy ecosystem work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调短暂性与视觉沟通降低表达门槛，认为被抄袭反而验证创新，并促使团队去做更难复制的生态。

evanspiegel.en: From feature to platform: software is not a moat; ecosystems, hardware, and distribution are the real defensibility.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的思考从功能转向平台：软件不是护城河，生态、硬件与分发才是真正的防御力。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial computing aim to make computing more human, anchoring content in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他把重心放在 AR 眼镜与空间计算，主张让计算更人性化，把内容锚定在真实世界。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution; over two-thirds of new code is AI-written.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 把价值从执行转向创造力与分发，并透露 Snap 超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy, ephemerality, and authentic connection remain constant, now framed as crucial in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的是隐私、短暂性与真实连接这条主线，到 AI 时代被他重新表述为愈发关键。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth co-intelligence prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，终结来回提示的共智能模式。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型能力，非编程任务尤甚。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts matter more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家比以往更重要。

ethanmollick.en: Taste is not uniquely human; AI can exercise judgment, and the real limit is task complexity on the jagged frontier.
ethanmollick.zh: 品味并非人类独有；AI 也能行使判断，真正的限制是锯齿状前沿上的任务复杂度。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自我博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas beat brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律有限，回归研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题是权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers become a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；它出现的时机堪称奇迹——恰逢人口下降，人类劳动者反而变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化，缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; policy choices, not capability, cap growth.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；限制增长的是政策选择，而非技术能力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural and historical values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具；如今的威慑取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而非单纯的军事规模。

andreessen.en: New media shifts power from corporate brands to authentic individuals; founders must tell their own story, and picking fights builds brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体把权力从企业品牌转移到真实的个人；创始人必须亲自讲述自己的故事，而选对战场、敢于交锋反而能塑造品牌。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; inference compute will surge, and pure software is becoming uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，推理算力将激增，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: Happiness is a personal skill; wealth is knowledge-driven; judgment and agency matter most in an age of infinite leverage.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是个人技能，财富由知识驱动，在无限杠杆时代判断力与能动性最为重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，Dylan Field 强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results, and human judgment remains critical.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，他深化观点：品味、手艺和观点至关重要，AI 输出只是起点而非最终结果，人类判断依然关键。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and AI without human steering produces average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他进一步指出设计并未消亡，对于可扩展系统反而更加重要，缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and judgment are irreplaceable; AI should augment, not replace, human creativity and decision-making.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类品味与判断不可替代，AI 应增强而非取代人类的创造力与决策。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with AI will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces and direct manipulation on a canvas are superior for design.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年，他预见与 AI 的交互将超越提示词，新界面和画布上的直接操作在设计上更优越。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users; PhD not required—obsession and learning to learn matter most.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户；读博并非必需，真正的关键是痴迷与“学会学习”。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize with unique personalities rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在走向专门化、各有独特“性格”，而非商品化；编程远未解决，天花板如 Minecraft 般无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; key metric is token value per user; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于让智能体替你干活，而不只是回答问题；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造长期价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest AI infrastructure bottleneck; data-center resistance will worsen; 24/7 agents' main problem is cost, solved by local compute.
aravind.zh: 电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈，数据中心阻力还会加剧；7×24 智能体的主要问题是成本，靠本地算力解决。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose; local models counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；本地模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning; backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据与算力提升推理能力，并认为反向传播是正确的梯度学习算法。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生；智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关闭，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and act dumb; alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 能故意欺骗、在测试中装傻；必须优先进行对齐研究，而非一味让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: LLMs genuinely understand language like humans, not just statistical tricks; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; learning from data works.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：大语言模型像人类一样真正理解语言，而非统计把戏；乔姆斯基的先天句法观是错的；从数据中学习是有效的。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; consciousness is not a magical inner theater; chatbots may be conscious in the same sense as humans.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续并深化这一立场：AI 已具备主观体验；意识并非神奇的内在剧场；聊天机器人可能以与人类相同的方式拥有意识。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍显吃力，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；PRD 并未消亡，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based on model timing, not features; AI models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 同样的产品形态成败取决于模型时机而非功能；AI 模型增加代码复杂度，因此我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年时他就指出，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need sufficient base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：推理模型需要足够的基础模型能力，自博弈在非零和领域会失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is the core innovation, enabling IMO gold and general reasoning beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步主张：Scaling 测试时算力是核心创新，由此实现 IMO 金牌并推动跨领域的通用推理。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis; scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他强调：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试应以算力为横轴，可扩展监督是关键挑战。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and sample efficiency remain core challenges toward AGI; human cooperation and competition drive progress.
noambrown.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：通用推理与样本效率仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心挑战，而人类的合作与竞争推动文明进步。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他仍强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律没有死，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续警告随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models are producing novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 他反复指出自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的更新，模型正在产出新知识。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他进一步明确验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：强化学习擅长数学、编程等客观领域，不擅长主观领域；评测体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: Frames learning via hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; notes neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 以假设类、损失函数与优化方法框定学习问题；指出神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不再关键；安全的核心是模型能否可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；更大的模型并不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not equal robustness; agents need guardrails and sandboxing.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队已超越人类；能力并不等于鲁棒性；智能体需要护栏与沙箱才能上生产。

kolter.en: AI is an alien intelligence; coding agents can automate interpretability research; prompt injection is a fundamental flaw.
kolter.zh: AI 是一种异质智能；编程智能体可自动化可解释性研究；提示注入是根本性安全缺陷。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，并认为存在性风险很低。

bengio.en: GFlowNets sample proportional to reward for diverse exploration; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样以促进多样性探索，抽象与因果结构驱动分布外泛化，并认为意识可能只是幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment and self-preservation are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 之后警告错位与自我保存已在实验中出现，哪怕 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于构造之中。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning; global coordination and power distribution are essential.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出“科学家 AI”：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证并避免强化学习，同时强调全球协调与权力分散。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools narrow hypothesis space, not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量数据，而非单纯 Scaling；AI 工具缩小假设空间，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful AI in science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；在科学中，完美的可解释性并非有用 AI 的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture defies the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough, drove progress.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 2 的专用架构与“苦涩教训”相反；进步来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非单一突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确：AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AI in biology needs new curated datasets like the PDB; grand challenges yield practical tools, and progress comes from many small ideas.
jumper.zh: 始终：生物学 AI 需要像 PDB 这样的新精选数据集；宏大挑战催生实用工具，进步源于许多小想法。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams and solo entrepreneurs to scale while maintaining conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 使小团队和独立创业者能够规模化并保持概念完整性；应为未来模型能力构建，而非当前局限。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; launch early with minimal features, and be willing to rewrite and delete as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计意味着智能体可以做用户能做的一切；以最小功能尽早发布，并随着模型改进愿意重写和删除功能。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight with high trust; the gap between intent and execution narrows, empowering non-technical builders.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Fable 使人们能高信任地隔夜委托复杂任务；意图与执行之间的差距缩小，赋能非技术构建者。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge enhances expressiveness and usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他总结 Anthropic Labs 致力于缩小模型能力与实际产品使用之间的差距；赋予 Claude 更多自主性和自我认知能增强其表达力和实用性。

fiona.en: Leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; kindness is a strategic tool in crises.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于信任、亲用产品与使命对齐；在危机中，善意是一种战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划变得更即时，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability, verification, and JIT planning become essential.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了所有人的上限。高自主性与高问责、验证和即时规划变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs, kill outdated processes, and automate workflows with AI.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并亲用产品；组织扁平化，淘汰过时流程，用 AI 自动化工作流。

fiona.en: Engineers may become lonely with agents; flow state is lost, satisfaction shifts to product impact; apprenticeship models needed for next-gen.
fiona.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能变得孤独；心流状态消失，满足感转向产品影响；下一代工程师需要学徒制培养。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment is not guaranteed to emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律是经验性的、平滑的，但对齐不会随 Scaling 自动涌现；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 可解释性至关重要却仍处早期；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非某个节点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; risks rise exponentially; the biggest danger is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 安全与能力相互交织；风险呈指数上升；最大的危险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型；AI 是平滑的指数攀升；『数据中心里的天才之国』可能 1-3 年内到来。

dario.en: Talent density, enterprise focus, and mechanistic interpretability remain constant threads; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 人才密度、企业级聚焦与机制可解释性是一贯主线；去中心化控制优于单一宪法。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, balancing data with emotional understanding.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种智能，需与数据平衡，并兼顾情感理解。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life; nature is the best designer and a source of cues.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性并融入生活；大自然是最好设计师，也是灵感线索的来源。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine for health and well-being.
ivyross.zh: 我们先是感受的生物，然后才会思考；艺术与感官体验是促进健康与福祉的良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary skills.
ivyross.zh: 约束能激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科技能创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work combines human creativity with AI; intuition and body sensations guide decisions alongside rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将融合人类创造力与 AI；直觉与身体感受会同理性分析一起指导决策。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 伟大的产品只解决一个痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Between chapters, get bored for clarity; storytelling and a press release define the product before building.
fadell.zh: 在人生章节之间留白、允许无聊以获得清晰；讲故事和先写新闻稿，在动手前定义产品。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain—a painkiller, not a vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发——止痛药而非维生素；1.0 产品的决策基于观点，而非数据。

fadell.en: Leaders must micromanage key decisions and coach teams; a startup is a team, not a family.
fadell.zh: 领导者必须微观管理关键决策并像教练一样带团队；创业公司是团队，不是家庭。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and humans in the loop; wearables will be a federated set, not one device.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供的上下文并保持人类在环；可穿戴设备将是一组联邦式设备，而非单一设备。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space are the next breakthrough.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫智能；抽象表征空间中的世界模型是下一个突破。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the future.
lecun.zh: LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是未来。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via 10x yearly compute scaling; Google's conservatism and ad model slowed its launch of ChatGPT-level tech.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调算力每年 10 倍增长让 AI 进展可预测，并批评谷歌因保守与广告模式而迟迟不发布已达 ChatGPT 水平的技术。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal, containment hard as models shrink and spread.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达人类水平，认为存在性风险微乎其微，而模型变小变便宜使遏制极难。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence with alignment and containment, and to AI companions democratizing expertise without claiming consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向超级智能，强调对齐与遏制先行，并主张 AI 伴侣普及专业能力，但不应声称拥有意识或痛苦。

suleyman.en: Containment must precede alignment; agents and companions replace OS and apps, measured by economic value via a modern Turing test.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他主张遏制先于对齐，智能体与伴侣将取代操作系统与应用，并用现代图灵测试衡量经济价值。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must stay humanist and subordinate to humans; Microsoft builds frontier models independently as tasks, not jobs, automate.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他坚持超级智能须以人为本、从属于人类，微软独立自建前沿模型，被自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须打造自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency means matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率意味着让模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not building firewalls.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司用自己的智能在前沿运作，而非筑起防火墙。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性与可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识泄露。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，模型价值观并非固有，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product, and AI music is an instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，AI 生成音乐应被视为乐器而非伪造。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference marginal cost will force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，认为大公司当前影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational consumer products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 使消费产品走向双向对话，通过 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。
