gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key during technological shifts.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，在技术变革期率先拥抱变化是关键，并强调同步游泳而非分而治之的组织模式。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback drive alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公众反馈推动对齐。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并为了专注而对好想法说不。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get alignment right.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，才能做好对齐。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；保持人类在环。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is essential for scaling reasoning; informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证是扩展推理的关键；仅靠非形式模型无法达到超级智能。

carinahong.en: Verified generation improves performance and sample efficiency, making verification a gain, not a burden.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成能提升性能和样本效率，使验证成为一种收益而非负担。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 即使 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification enables open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式验证能促进开放协作。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on local computer access and shared tools, not hyper-personalized software; scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问本地计算机和共享工具，而非超个性化软件；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing AI can solve almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类做创造性工作；最大差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts and auto-refreshing dashboards connect personal data sources; use Sonnet for scoped tasks and Opus for open-ended ones.
felixrieseberg.zh: 实时工件和自动刷新仪表盘可连接个人数据源；范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，开放式任务用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask; being polite to AI improves your humanity, not model performance.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子擅长用 AI，因为他们没学会哪些不该问；对 AI 礼貌提升的是你自己的人性，而非模型表现。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact. Ideal interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude，只看最终影响。理想交互是异步的：发出任务后不必盯着它工作。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and RL now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 到 2025 年，预训练缩放定律依然成立，但带思维链和强化学习的推理模型每单位算力收益更高。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure favors smaller, cheaper models; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，经济压力推动更小更便宜的模型；是蒸馏而非技术极限放缓了预训练 Scaling。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，推理模型呈“锯齿状”：某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; humans generalize from few examples.
kaiser.zh: 到 2026 年，带推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；人类却能从少量样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but needs careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，Codex 等编程智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但需谨慎监督。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他引用 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, with 100x algorithmic gains possible.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步深化：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，算法改进三年可带来 100 倍提升。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱风险而非回避。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; value shifts to vertical specialization, customized fine-tuning, and agentic enterprise software.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，价值转向垂直专业化、定制化微调与智能体式企业软件。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window for AI sovereignty and practical integration.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他明确 AGI 是方向而非终点，欧洲只剩两年窗口构建 AI 主权，真正挑战是实际整合与组织变革。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care for the creative process are constant; fragile ideas need protection, not just innate talent.
jonyive.zh: 对创造过程的好奇与珍视始终如一：脆弱的想法需要被呵护，而非仅靠天赋。

jonyive.en: Simplicity now means expressing a product's essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，简洁被深化为以喜悦与人性表达产品本质，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, making things for each other rather than for profit.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，为彼此而造，而非追逐利润或市场趋势。

jonyive.en: Innovation is a deliberate risky bet; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes, and authenticity rejects fake mimicry.
jonyive.zh: 创新是一场刻意的冒险：传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验拒绝虚假模仿。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics is shaped by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity govern latency-cost tradeoffs.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小与稀疏度决定延迟与成本的权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates; context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍，因为推理成本占主导；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Inside AI chips, data movement costs dominate compute; low precision yields quadratic area savings, making FP4 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 在 AI 芯片内部，数据移动成本主导计算；低精度带来二次方面积节省，使 FP4 吞吐达 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存内存但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏度而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory enable deterministic, data-reuse-efficient parallelism.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多微小 TPU 的拼接；脉动阵列与暂存内存实现确定性、数据复用高效的并行。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation is needed.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information confuses models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的缩放轴；搜索、代码执行等工具让模型具备智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid; synthetic data reuse creates harmful feedback loops.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客；合成数据简单复用会造成有害反馈循环。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵，否则会悄然发生模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; decade of agents, not year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；这是智能体的十年，而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is weak, cognitive core can be tiny, entropy prevents collapse.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；强化学习很弱，认知核心可以很小，熵能防止崩溃。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: delegate to agents, but understanding stays the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 从氛围编程到智能体式工程：把工作委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在，同时强调安全是系统级属性而非模型本身的产物。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，并反复强调数据质量远比算法选择重要。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and systems issues persist.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，能催生推理与工具使用能力，但也指出过优化与系统层面的工程难题依然存在。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已被摘完，收益正转向后训练与推理侧扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, yet lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead openness.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但始终落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，而中国实验室在开放度上领先。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他提出传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的设计往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers spend 30-40% time mocking up, must help engineers execute, and look 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初，他进一步断言研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；设计师花在画稿上的时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，必须帮助工程师执行，设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 AI 时代的三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋新人；仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力和权威才是关键。

jennywen.en: Craft and attention to detail are crucial; the process never truly produced great work—designers' care did.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：手艺和对细节的关注至关重要；流程从未真正产出伟大作品，是设计师的用心做到了这一点。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 另一条贯穿始终的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；设计师应掌控 AI 进入自己工作的程度。

askell.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对 AI 的道德地位不确定，也应善待模型；模型福利会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies; core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对其全新存在，而非简单套用人类类比；应具备带有良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompt avoids over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；系统提示中的欧陆哲学有助于模型避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: As models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的明确指导、更多的判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial; AI should empower people, not disempower them.
askell.zh: AI 价值观与训练目标的透明度至关重要；AI 应赋能于人，而非削弱人的能力。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key for real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是真实机器人的关键。

pathak.en: Model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies improve robot motion and zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他提出以模型分歧作为内在奖励实现可微分好奇心，并用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略提升机器人运动与零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; long childhood with goal-free exploration correlates with higher intelligence across species.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，跨物种来看，漫长的童年与无目标探索和更高智能相关。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot, using pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向机器人是数据问题，像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，路径是视频与模拟预训练加真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; video alone is insufficient, and a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出部署本身是首要技术挑战而非仅商业问题，仅靠视频不够，跨垂直领域的数据飞轮才能从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; scaling and world models solve autonomous driving, not new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码系统，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）和世界模型解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation and introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为世界模型支持推理和涌现安全行为，语言集成提升表征与内省能力。

kendall.en: Data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：通过课程学习和合成数据提升数据效率至关重要，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他提出零样本泛化到 500 多个城市可行，消费级车辆将在中短期内超越 Robotaxi 规模。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now winning; safety always has a third option, trolley problem is theoretical.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他反思端到端学习十年前被嘲笑如今成为赢家，安全总有第三选项，电车难题是理论问题。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and safety progress is now driven by capability needs.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；长期对齐的核心在于超越训练分布的泛化。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule all, and every company should eventually train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Human judgment becomes more critical as AI hallucinates; in medicine, safety must outweigh accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 随着 AI 产生幻觉，人类判断愈发关键；在医学中，安全必须优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

edwinchen.en: AI can transform clinical workflow via summarization and RAG, but using it to avoid struggle undermines learning.
edwinchen.zh: AI 可通过摘要和检索增强生成变革临床工作流，但用它来逃避思考会损害学习。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，初创公司必须先活下来、从简单产品做起，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心，而非事后补丁。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI memory needs trust, and hardware-only margins are lowest.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在于生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件；AI 记忆功能必须建立在信任与透明之上，而纯硬件公司利润最低，必须向应用 AI 演进。

carlpei.en: LLMs are commoditizing into a price war; most AI is BS, so AI should be an invisible ingredient solving real user pain.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为大语言模型正商品化并陷入价格战，多数 AI 是伪需求；AI 应作为隐形成分解决真实用户痛点，甚至主张在产品讨论中禁用‘AI’一词。

carlpei.en: In mature categories, differentiation beats product-market fit; design is the fastest way to stand out.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步提出在成熟品类中差异化比产品市场契合更重要，设计是脱颖而出最快的方式，并以此解释 Nothing 的品牌策略。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from apps to intent-based agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化交互判断：手机将从应用转向基于意图的智能体，应用会消失，公司应开放 API 迎接 AI 智能体；只有脑机接口能取代手机，而非眼镜。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 用于科学应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends from protein structures to biomolecular interactions, including DNA, RNA, and small molecules.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到生物分子相互作用，涵盖 DNA、RNA 和小分子。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出，基于强化学习的后训练是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; chat is not the future interface, like MS-DOS before Windows. The model is the product, iterated like software.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的；聊天不是未来界面，就像 Windows 之前的 MS-DOS。模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大化加速。

turley.en: AI should not replace humans but amplify human capability, keeping users in the driver's seat with a personalized assistant.
turley.zh: AI 不应取代人类，而应放大人类能力，让用户掌握主动权，拥有个性化助手。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、丰富可供性的产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capabilities like microscopes; generalist agents tokenize all inputs into sequences toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他视 AI 为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为将一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn this way.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张像人类一样从 YouTube 视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体，机器人也应如此。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges today; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确将 AI 安全与负责任部署视为当今最大挑战，并承认我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it has leapfrogged legacy issues and can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 上并未落后，反而跨越了遗留问题，并能用语言模型革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 始终不变的是，他认为 AI 领域的多样性与包容性至关重要，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data beyond the internet's tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，而非仅服务于机器人：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的真实经验，且当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: Research taste for simple, elegant solutions is crucial and scalable, unlike complex modular approaches common in academia.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他强调对简单优雅解法的研究品味至关重要且可扩展，这与学术界常见的复杂模块化路线形成对照。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的核心瓶颈，认为来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人学习的未来——从强调具身数据无限，深化为如何生成这些数据。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张简单的端到端机器人基础模型是关键，把「机器人打扫乱房间」的物理图灵测试视为终极挑战，并预测机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，而家用因安全与非结构化环境会更晚。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Most intelligence is pattern matching, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决新任务接入问题并大幅提升智能；大部分智能是模式匹配，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, adding a new scaling axis. Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，增加了新的 Scaling 轴；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，编程是领先指标。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the bottleneck, not capability. Economic impact is initially limited by human management bandwidth.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（随时间跨度的成功率）是瓶颈，而非能力；经济影响最初受限于人类管理带宽。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing. Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed. Inference compute will bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为进展是指数级的，并未停滞；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构；推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more now. Future work is managing AI agent teams; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩意味着工具和编排更重要；未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队；算力是新石油。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 下一个词预测与人类学习方式根本错位；更小的模型若配上更好的算法与数据，也能在特定任务上胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
yejin.zh: 数据才是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越它。

yejin.en: RL needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning; open research is crucial to compete with closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精心工程才能胜过监督微调；开放研究对于与闭源前沿模型实验室竞争至关重要。

yejin.en: Small models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet.
yejin.zh: 小模型借助多样化的合成数据也能变得强大；多元对齐比试图给互联网去偏更可行。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt, maximizing learning through rapid experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还，通过快速实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，以代码为真相来源；90 年代图层面板工具已是遗产。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform large cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于大型跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是常态；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and code, not Figma libraries, to ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉的模式与代码而非 Figma 组件库，才能快速交付。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions, designer empowerment, ship fast and iterate over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切追求速度：清晰决策、赋予设计师权力，快速交付并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清楚设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是吸引人才的招聘工具。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律能预测进步，但测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体虽有前景但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed, and cost—an unexpected shift from relying on frontier models.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本变得不可或缺——这是从依赖前沿模型到自研的意外转变。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网影响更深远、持续数十年；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更重要。

abbeel.en: Early focus: RL and imitation learning for robots; fine-tuning pre-trained models; hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 早期关注：用强化学习与模仿学习训练机器人；通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移；长时程信用分配需要分层推理，但当前强化学习尚不具备。

abbeel.en: Shift to sample efficiency: unsupervised learning plus RL; prior knowledge for data generation, not hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 转向样本效率：无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升机器人样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码；预训练语言模型内化通用推理模式，可迁移至非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent thread: simulation and self-play as learning signal; anthropomorphism of robots; reliability benchmark for real-world value.
abbeel.zh: 一以贯之的主线：仿真与自对弈作为学习信号；人们天然将机器人拟人化；以可靠性基准衡量真实世界价值。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills in alignment and robustness.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，应优先培养对齐与鲁棒性方面的技能。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment are needed.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now rather than waiting for superintelligence.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐方法必须经过实证检验，现在就能衡量进展，而非等到超级智能出现。

leike.en: The core risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment alone.
leike.zh: 另一条主线是：核心风险在于无法确定系统是否真正对齐，而不仅仅是对齐失败本身。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes models smarter, though we still don't understand what happens inside.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力和数据——让模型更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains a killer app, but the best applications are unforeseen; product managers often hinder LLM development due to misunderstanding its generality.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但最佳应用常出乎创造者意料；产品经理因不理解 LLM 的通用性而常阻碍开发。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; future models need much longer context windows, potentially trillions of tokens, enabled by modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；未来模型需要更长的上下文窗口，可能达万亿 token，这要靠混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by taking actions in the world, not just passively observing data; continual learning with modular, independently trainable components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他进一步主张：模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；用模块化、可独立训练的组件进行持续学习，可取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding are crucial, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他明确：测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式能力、强化学习和编程至关重要，而 AGI 的经济影响被低估了。
